title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendoring + rke2/rocky support
author: Aisha Rahman
description: This PR adds RockyLinux (Rocky 9) support to the on-prem/airgap offline bundle pipeline and updates vendored dependencies used by the private installer. Motivation: customers deploying private clusters on RKE2 with Rocky images hit missing packaging and kernel module mismatches during airgapped installs. This change: 1) Adds a new vendor manifest and packaging layer to include Rocky-compatible rpms and initrd hooks. 2) Extends the offline-bundle builder to pull and sign Rocky artifacts via TUF mirror logic so customers can validate bundles. 3) Updates Helm charts with tolerations and nodeSelector tweaks for RKE2 on Rocky. 4) Small Terraform module adjustments to expose imagePullSecrets and substrate labels for airgap registries. 5) Adds rollback-tooling docs and tests for bundling and upgrade scenarios. All description content is contained in this field as a single continuous string.
